TSUKIMI EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Fubbit!!
You're here...
Lady Kaguya! I care about the moon because\nI love you! Hop!
I want you to witness this fountain of knowledge\ndries up with your beautiful eyes!
As usual, I don't really understand what you're\nsaying~.
All right, oh dear moon, which one of them is more\nsuitable to be the ruler~...?!
The challenge today is a test about the "history",\n"local specialty", and finally "creative dance" of\nthe moon and Uraluna...
What?! Creative dance~?
You'll need to dance according to the theme given\nto you to express what you visualize in your mind\nthrough movements...
Whatever you wish, my lady! I'm ready to rumble,\nand so is everyone else!
Okay then, let's begin with the history\nquestion...About 400 years ago, a major incident\nthat rocked the moon and Uraluna happened.
What was it? I want you to write your answer on\nthe card near you before the time runs out.
Er...Hop! Lady Kaguya, if it's possible, please\ngive us a hint...
I can't believe both of you are asking for a hint\nalready. How pathetic...
The hint for this question is...\nOh, what an unexpected betrayal!
It doesn't matter who answers faster here!\nYou don't have to hit the buzzer, you know~?
The Hopwick Temple Incident
King Hopthur's birthday
Invention of the Hopthagory theorem
Oh, wow?! That's a pretty nice answer, isn't it?\nWe'll check the answer together soon~!
The traitor's birthday?\nSo it's not today?
The invention of a theorem? I'm not sure if it was\nthe major event that actually rocked the moon and\nUraluna.
Ding-dong!
Didn't I tell ya that this isn't a buzzer round?!\nAlso, please don't make that sound with your\nmouth!
Hmph, you've completely failed to understand the\nhint from Lady Kaguya, silly!
That major incident was..."the release of the\nHop Hop Dance Song"!
What's that?
What...?
The summer festival hit song "Hop Hop Dance Song"\nwas made into a record and released!
That song was a masterpiece, but they released it\ntoo late. Many people felt betrayed!
Allow me to say this first. You're wrong,\nFubbit...
W-what did you say?!
You're absolutely correct!\n2 points for you!
Way to go!\nAll that studying was worth it!
The Hopwick Temple Incident was an event where\nUsanaga, an influential figure on the moon, was\nbetrayed by his vassal, Hopketch, who was born
in Uraluna. They say the relationship between\nthe moon and Uraluna became bad because of that.
Your answer is actually not very good either,\nbut since it's related to history, it's better\nthan Fubbit's answer. You get 1 point...
I have a feeling that this game is gonna be\nboring.
The winner of the "history" round is the\nadventurer!
Dammit!\nI'll turn things around in the next round!
Next, I'll ask you a question about the "local\nspecialty" of the moon and Uraluna...
Please tell me the popular local specialty of\nthe moon and Uraluna that has been around for\nabout 400 years...
I think I know the answer~.
Er, Lady Kaguya? A hint if possible...?
...Why are you two asking for a hint again?\nDon't you think that's too much?
The hint for this question is...\nIt's smooth and chewy with a soft texture!
How many times do I have to tell you that it's not\na buzzer round?! There's not even a buzzer button\nhere!
Tsukimi Dango
Tsukimi Mango
Tsukimi Radish
Yeah, that's it~! I know you know it! Maybe you'll\nwin again!
Probably yes. I can't deny that...
We love kiwis and papayas~! Let's pound mochi\ntogether under the full moon~!
Yum yum! Throw one into the pot, and voila! We get\ntasty and flavorful oden! Um, well the season is\nalmost here, but it's not related to the moon~.
Ding-dong!
Tch, didn't I tell ya not to make that sound with\nyour...? Argh, fine, do whatever you want~!
Ha, you've definitely made a mistake this time...\nWhen Lady Kaguya said "smooth", it actually means\na smooth-talker!
Hm?
What?
I have a smooth tongue and I'm a good speaker!\nCome closer and listen to me speaking elegantly!\nHop!
It is fundamental to be suave and smooth to rule\nthe moon and Uraluna...So the answer is\n"Tsukimi Smoothie Conference".
Okay, you're wrong, Fubbit...
W-w-wh-whaat?!
You're absolutely correct!\n2 points for you!
You're not to be underestimated! You've been\nstudying harder than I thought!
Tsukimi Dango has remained very popular on the\nmoon and Uraluna for centuries! It's still very\npopular now!
Fubbit's answer doesn't make sense at all...\nAs your answer is still related to food, I'll take\nit and give you 1 point...
This is so boring~. If there were people watching,\nthey'd be getting up and leaving their seats.
The winner of the "local specialty" round is the\nadventurer too!
Ugh! I never thought that someone who was just\nmessing around like you would
become my greatest opponent! I really didn't see\nthis coming!!
But I'll have the last laugh!!
For the final round, you'll be competing in a\n"creative dance" that represents the moon and\nUraluna...
And the winner of this round will get 10 points!
Uh-huh, that means he can still turn it around...\nWait, are you kidding me?! Then all the points the\nadventurer has won so far would be meaningless!
I believe that I must keep the promise that I've\nmade...
Welp, I can sorta understand that, but...Argh!\nJust focus on winning!! Hey, make sure to ace it!
Theme: The World on the Moon!
Theme: Rabbit's Cuteness Showdown!
Theme: Inseparable Dango Trio!
The shift from a thrusting pose to a sudden\ndisplay of extreme self-assertion! I can feel how\npassionate you are about the world on the moon!
Alright, let's see how many points you get!!
10 points from Senior Judge Kaguya, 10 points from\nChief Judge Kaguya, and 10 points from Supreme\nJudge Kaguya...The total is 30 points...
Oh wow, a perfect score right from the\nbeginning~!!
Nice~! I thought you were gonna stick to that\nuncool bunny-hop style till the end, but luckily\nthere were some cute & sweet moves at the end~!
Alright, let's see how many points you get!!
10 points from Senior Judge Kaguya, 10 points from\nChief Judge Kaguya, and 10 points from Supreme\nJudge Kaguya...The total is 30 points...
Yeah~! A perfect score again! You're not backing\ndown at all, are you?!
A creative dance inspired by Tsukimi Dango, how\nclever~!
It's a bit unorthodox to have Tsukimi Dango with\nfillings like red bean paste or mustard, but as\nlong as it tastes good, I'm okay with it!
Alright, let's see how many points you get!!
10 points from Senior Judge Kaguya, 10 points from\nChief Judge Kaguya, and 10 points from Supreme\nJudge Kaguya...The total is 30 points...
A full score too for the final dance~!!\nThis popular kid~!!\nThe dance floor is yours tonight~!!
Hmph, you're quite good...\nIt won't be fun if you're not good.
Watch and remember our dazzling steps and graceful\nhip sway, hop! I hope I can pass it on to my\nchildren and grandchildren!
There he goes again, rambling on about weird\nthings...
Play the music!
Your performance was pretty good too, Fubbit~!\nThat intense spin and all those adorable moves\nwere entertaining!
Alright, let's see how many points you get!!
10 points, 10 points, and 10 points...The total is\n30 points...
A flawless start for Fubbit too~!!\nThis competition is getting interesting!
うぬぬ、冒険者……\nここまで食い下がるとは、みどももぴょん！\n思わなかったでおじゃる。
しかし、つぎはツキノウラ伝統の\n“不死鳥うさぎの舞”でおじゃるぞ！\nええいっ！　お囃子（はやし）を奏でい！
Oh dear...I never expected you to be so\npersistent, hop!
But the next performance will be the traditional\n"Mochi-Pounding Rabbit Dance" from Uraluna!\nOh yeah! Play the music!
Thump, thump! Looks like we're having a\nmochi-pounding dance battle~!
うぬぬ、冒険者……\nここまで食い下がるとは、みどももぴょん！\n思わなかったでおじゃる。
しかし、つぎはツキノウラ伝統の\n“ツキの曇るまでうさぎの舞”でおじゃるぞ！\nええいっ！　お囃子（はやし）を奏でい！
うさぎの跳躍を思わせる高速ステップが\n決まったぁ～！　右に左にぴょんこぴょんこ\n跳ねて楽しそうじゃんね～！
さぁ！　得点はいかに！？
10 points, 10 points, and 10 points...The total is\n30 points...
You're doing great, you haven't lost yet!\nFubbit is putting up a good fight!!
Huff, huff...My legs are shaking like jelly...
I'll dance with all my heart even if it means\nbreaking my legs. Watch my beautiful performance\non this stage like flowers blooming in Uraluna!
Alright, my final dance is the Rabbit Tail-Wagging\nDance! Play the music!
Hop?! I can't move my legs. I can't believe this\nis happening now, how embarrassing!!
Don't tell me you're running out of energy now~?\nYou both have been performing so perfectly up to\nthis point, so this ending is kinda...
Alright, let's see how many points you get!!
9 points, 8 points, and 9 points...The total is\n26 points...
Oops, too bad, Fubbit~!\nI guess there's no need to continue this\ncompetition. You've won~!
Ugh...This is just too embarrassing for Fubbit///
Lady Kaguya, I know I'm being rude! But I insist\non taking you to my territory, Uraluna! Hop!
I'm sure one day you will understand!
Um...
Is that who Fubbit really is?!\nHey, he's planning to kidnap Kaguya!
Get out of the way!!\nIf you continue to get in my way, you're gonna\nget hurt!
Ugh, I can't believe I lost...
They say, "...We'll protect Master Fubbit...!"
They say, "...How dare you interfere! We'll use\nthe momentum of this victory to crush you...!"
Stop it!!!
Lady Kaguya...
Fubbit, now I understand how you feel about the\nmoon...
Let's put the marriage problem aside for now.\nI think we should build a strong bond between the\nmoon and Uraluna first...
And for that, I have decided to play my trump\ncard...
Your trump card?
What?! What's about to happen?!
This is the power hidden in the tail of the ruler\nof the moon...It's called "Lunamorphosis".
I can mix the world of the moon with the world of\nUraluna with it...
Wow...
When that happens, everyone will have no choice\nbut to be friends and get along...
I have been reluctant to use it because it feels\nlike I'm deceiving and betraying everyone...
...Hop...Lady Kaguya, please hold that power back\nfor the time being...
Huh?
I was wrong...\nIt was foolish of me to think that I could make\nyou love me by using violence.
And because of that, you're forced to do something\nthat you actually don't want to do...
Fubbit...
Give me one more chance, Lady Kaguya...
After studying the moon, taking care of Uraluna,\nand becoming a man who deserves to rule both of\nthem, hop, I'll come back for you again...
Hey, let's go back to Uraluna...
Welp, he's definitely a fool, but I guess it's a\ngood thing that he's a fool who knows his mistake\nand wants to learn from it.
No, don't call him stupid. That's too much...\nFubbit has always been a serious and honest guy...
Well, just marry him then~!\nThat way he would be happy too.
T-that's a different story!
Anyway, as promised, I'll give you your rewards...
Also, I'm happy that you have studied about the\nmoon. I'll give you extra reward...
If you ever need a job, I'd be more than happy to\nhire you as my servant.
It seems that this event has boosted your\nreputation this time...
Also, I'm happy that you have studied about the\nmoon harder than I thought. I'll give you extra\nreward...
You'll become more familiar with the moon if you\nexplore it...
But there's nothing to explore except the moon's\nsurface~.
Oh well, I'm fine with it as long as I get my\nreward though. Anyway, at the end of the day,\nthe basic problem remains unresolved~.
What do you mean?
I mean the bad blood between the moon and Uraluna.\nYou're always worried about it too, right?
Uhm...
You know what, it might actually...
Yeah, it might actually get sorted out sooner than\nyou think~.
